column1: # Absences that are REAL but INVISIBLE to the weekly injury report.
# WHY THIS FILE HAS TO EXIST. The official Week 10 report lists only players a club submitted
# during that week's practice-window cadence. A player on injured reserve is not submitted, so
# he never appears on the report - and an availability layer built only from the report silently
# treats him as no-absence. Verified against the Week 10 report: Baltimore's report carries 8
# rows and none of them is a quarterback, while the league's own news feed has the Ravens'
# franchise QB confirmed out for 6-10 weeks. See flags.json F-17.
# Each row below is transcribed from an official NFL.com news headline. `pos` is only recorded
# where the headline itself states the position; that keeps the row sourced rather than inferred.

column4: Ravens confirm Lamar Jackson expected to miss 6-10 weeks
Report: Ravens QB Tyler Huntley out for season with turf toe injury
Dolphins place QB Malik Willis (groin) on injured reserve
Sam Darnold ruled out for Seahawks' Week 10 game vs. Raiders
